name: WPRobo Engage Lite
author: WPRobo Limited

sections.description:
WPRobo Engage helps you build and launch conversion campaigns — popups, floating bars, and slide-ins — without writing a single line of code.

Features

  • Unlimited Campaigns – Create as many campaigns as you need
  • Popup Campaigns – Exit-intent, timed, and scroll-based popups
  • Floating Bar – Sticky header/footer notification bars
  • Slide-In Campaigns – Corner slide-in opt-in forms
  • Template Library – 10+ pre-built templates to get started fast
  • Smart Display Rules – Show or hide campaigns by page, post, category, tag, or URL
  • Basic Analytics – Track impressions and conversion rates
  • Lead Management – View and export collected leads
  • Third-Party Form Embed – Paste embed code from Mailchimp, ConvertKit, AWeber, and more
  • Import / Export – Transfer campaigns between sites as JSON
  • Role-Based Access – Control which admin roles can manage campaigns
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for “WPRobo Engage”
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate
  4. Navigate to WPRobo Engage in your admin menu to create your first campaign

Or manually:

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the ZIP and activate
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require an account or license key?

No. The free version is fully functional with no account or license required.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes. WPRobo Engage Pro adds A/B testing, advanced analytics, geolocation targeting, AI copywriting, and more. See https://wprobo.com for details.

Where can I get support?

Post in the WordPress.org support forum or visit https://wprobo.com/contact/
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Compliance: Renamed internal function/constant prefix from wpr_ to wpre_ to satisfy WordPress.org’s 4-character prefix requirement.
  • Fix: Schedule tab no longer wraps to a second row at narrow admin widths.
  • Fix: PRO badges in the admin now render with their intended styling (allow class attribute in wp_kses).
  • Fix: Upgrade button text now stays white across hover and active states.

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Popup, floating bar, and slide-in campaign types
  • Template library with 10+ pre-built templates
  • Smart display rules (page, post, category, tag, URL)
  • Basic analytics dashboard
  • Lead management with export
  • Third-party form embed support
  • Campaign import/export
